cyclist_f.name: Cyclist
dialog: See the humps in the floor down here?
Take them fast on a Bicycle and you fly. Nothing feels better!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Grant: A veteran, yes. An old man, no! Don't you go easy on me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Grant: Hah! So young, and already this good. I'll stay young at heart and try again.
